verdict.rationale: Sentry's own sentry-cli is documented to validate and upload debug information files for iOS and Android. Those files let Sentry extract stack traces for most compiled platforms. A community comment also confirms Sentry's Symbolicator is a real symbolication engine that a competitor reuses. missing for 10: explicit documentation naming dSYM and ProGuard mapping uploads, evidence that frames resolve to function names and line numbers, hands-on corroboration of mobile/native symbolication working end-to-end.
